messages:
maria: prepping a console/UI deploy — aiming for 17:00 UTC today. PR #2314 merged and CI green. Can the usual smoke runners be on standby? Ill kick off CDN invalidation after canary passes. :rocket:

dan: @maria I can take the canary slot. plan is to start canary at 17:05 UTC (5 nodes, ~5% traffic). will watch 200 ratios, new JS errors, and any bundle-related 5xx spikes.

sophia: ack, i'll run the post-canary smoke at ~17:12. Quick checklist: login, search, settings save, dashboard load. Small helper script below if you want to run it from a laptop:
```
# smoke checks
curl -s -I https://console.redwood.ai/ | head -n 1
curl -s "https://console.redwood.ai/api/search?q=test" | jq '.results | length'
curl -s -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/settings -d '{"theme":"dark"}'
```

raj: rollback readiness notes: validated stable tag yesterday (v2026.03.14). Agreed rollback thresholds: 1) 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 3m; 2) frontend error rate (sourcemap-matched) > 2x baseline; 3) p50 render time on /dashboard > 1.5s for 5m. Immediate rollback command below:
```
# rollback to stable
redwoodctl deploy console --image redwood-console:v2026.03.14 --traffic 100
```

maria: got it re thresholds. Ill post the traffic-shift timing in a minute. Quick ask: can someone confirm the CDN distribution id? I had ABCD1234 in notes but want a second pair of eyes.

dan: distribution id is ABCD1234 (CloudFront). Ill run a targeted invalidation after canary-green:
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id ABCD1234 --paths "/static/*" "/assets/*"
```
Ill wait for canary to be green before kicking this.

sophia: reminder to prime the edge for new chunk names  run a small warmup against key routes if you can. naive warmup script:
```
# warm edge for critical routes
for u in "/" "/dashboard" "/settings"; do curl -s https://console.redwood.ai$u > /dev/null; done
```

raj: short observability runbook for the rollout:
- open console.slo/dashboard -> check frontend latency overlay
- check traces for /dashboard and /api/search (3m window)
- check Sentry for new release tag `redwood-console@pr-2314`
- if user-facing errors exceed baseline, trigger rollback

deploy-bot: canary started on canary-3 at 2223456900  pushing 5% traffic.

dan: canary ~2m in, 200s look good, no new JS stack traces in Sentry yet.

sophia: running smoke now (17:12). login ok, search returns results, settings save ok, dashboard loads (p95 ~820ms locally). :white_check_mark:

dan: canary green. i'll shift to 25% then 50% over next 10m and monitor. @raj can you be ready to cut traffic if dashboards spike?

raj: on standby. rollback command prepped and permissions checked.

maria: proceeding with gradual ramp. Ill post timestamps for each shift. If anyone sees something odd, ping here and call rollback.

dan: shifting to 25% at 17:10 -> metrics: 200 ratio stable, error rate flat. shifting to 50% at 17:18 -> p50 render stable, no new Sentry releases. Will post final 100% timestamp.

sophia: continuing short checks: smoke flows still healthy after ramp. edge warmup hit critical routes.

maria: cut to 100% at 17:30 UTC. kicking CDN invalidation at 17:31 UTC. monitor window 30m per plan. Ill file a short post-deploy note in #eng-releases with smoke outputs.

deploy-bot: invalidation ABCD1234/ID-xyz-987 completed at 2223457550

maria: post-deploy smoke: all core flows healthy, no new regressions in Sentry, p95 dashboard ~820ms. Closing out this thread; thanks all! :tada:
